title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Terms: Processing Fee Relief on a Mortgage Loan File Revised Loan Estimate
content:
On a revised Loan Estimate for a Mortgage Loan File, processing relief is taken from the zero-tolerance charges according to the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file, one of Larkspur's Closing Cost Credit programs: its status and the occupation verified on it.

**Terms.** Where the Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file is verified for a firefighter, law enforcement or emergency medical occupation, the program's processing fee (as listed in the Larkspur program fee schedule) is taken off; where it is verified for an active military or veteran, k12 educator or nurse occupation, 200.00 USD is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

| Hometown Heroes Credit reserved against the file | Verified occupation | Processing relief |
|---|---|---|
| verified | firefighter, law enforcement or emergency medical | the program's processing fee |
| verified | active military or veteran, k12 educator or nurse | 200.00 USD |
| not verified, or none held | — | nothing |

Hypothetical illustrations: on a Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed file (processing fee 795.00 USD), a verified credit for a firefighter takes 795.00 USD off, and a verified credit for a nurse takes 200.00 USD off; on a Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed file, whose processing fee is 0.00, a verified credit for a firefighter takes 0.00 off.
